classification.difficultyReason: Explain a supplied two-copy rearrangement into a parallelogram and divide the known area expression bytwo; proof structure is already diagram-scaffolded.

content.prompt: Use the diagram to derive the formula for the area of the trapezium shown inside the parallelogram $ABCD$.

spec.description: Two congruent trapezia form enclosing parallelogramABCD; original b1/b2 split bases, commonh, parallel families and dashed construction retained.
spec.answerVisibility: Original givens/construction only; no derived area or radius displayed.

answer.worked:
The second, congruent trapezium completes a parallelogram of base $b_1+b_2$ and perpendicular height $h$. Its area is $(b_1+b_2)h$, twice the area of either trapezium.
$$\begin{aligned}2A&=(b_1+b_2)h\\A&=\frac12(b_1+b_2)h.\end{aligned}$$
